module: Flowgraph node "Set Recovery Prompt Button Enabled" (category once_instant). Enables or disables a recovery prompt button by id; if the button was inactive and is to be enabled, it is also activated. Input pins: id (suggested templates: flipMission, recoverMission, submitMission, restartMission), enabled.

postInit.desc: Sets the predefined values (hardTemplates) of the id pin: the four standard buttons.
